files.description: Bike-share riders, one per row (400 rows): rider_id (six-digit id with leading zeros), display_name (person name, some with accented letters), home_district (one of 6 districts such as "Old Town"), membership (casual, monthly or annual) - these three text columns have inconsistent capital letters and stray spaces; joined_on (date as text, YYYY-MM-DD; about 2% empty), birth_year (whole number; about 4% empty), credit_balance (two decimals, can be negative; about 5% empty).

task_text: Going down riders.csv in file order, add four columns change_1 to change_4 for every rider: change_k is 1 minus (the birth_year k rows above) divided by (this rider's birth_year). The first k riders have no change_k, and a value is empty when either birth_year involved is empty. `result` should be a table with the columns birth_year, change_1, change_2, change_3 and change_4, one row per rider in file order.
intended_computation: Read riders.csv; b = birth_year in file order; change_k[i] = 1 - b[i-k] / b[i] for k = 1..4, missing when i < k or either value is empty; columns birth_year, change_1..change_4; 400 rows in file order.

acceptable_variants.notes: values may be rounded to 6 significant digits; birth_year may be float

intent_summary: For each row and for each of the N = 4 rows above it, compute the change of the current value relative to that earlier value as 1 minus earlier/current, in four new columns that are empty where there are not enough rows above.
